gentle-morning.title: A gentle morning
gentle-morning.description: From one glass of water to a short morning routine that starts by itself, one small step at a time.
gentle-morning.why: Why do you want a calmer start to your day? In your own words.
gentle-morning.water.arrival: The path starts in your kitchen, with one glass of water.
gentle-morning.water.accept: The water is part of your morning now. You could add one minute of stretching after it.
gentle-morning.water.nugget: You could put the glass next to the tap in the evening, so it is the first thing you see in the morning.
gentle-morning.stretch-1.action: drink a glass of water and stretch for one minute
gentle-morning.stretch-1.arrival: A little more light comes through the window.
gentle-morning.stretch-1.accept: One minute became easy. You could give your stretch a few more minutes.
gentle-morning.stretch-1.nugget: Missing one morning is fine. What matters is coming back the next morning.
gentle-morning.stretch-5.action: drink a glass of water and stretch for five minutes
gentle-morning.stretch-5.arrival: The morning is getting longer, and something heavy pulls you back to bed.
gentle-morning.stretch-5.accept: The blanket stays on the bed now. You could end your routine with a short look at the day ahead.
gentle-morning.stretch-5.nugget: You could plan for a hard morning now: "If I oversleep, then I will just drink the water." The smaller step still counts.
gentle-morning.plan-day.action: drink a glass of water, stretch for five minutes and write down one thing for today
gentle-morning.plan-day.arrival: The sun is up. One last stretch of path, and the rush of the day tries to get ahead of you.
gentle-morning.plan-day.accept: Your morning has a shape now.
gentle-morning.plan-day.nugget: You could pair the stretch with something you enjoy, like a favourite song that you only play then.
gentle-morning.ending: Your morning starts by itself now: water, a stretch and one thing for the day.
